# Abyssal

> A multi-game Roblox script hub built on the Obsidian UI library. One entry
> script, one folder per game, no build step.

Abyssal runs in a Roblox executor. It fetches its own UI library and the script
for the current game from GitHub at run time, so pushing to `main` is the
release process.

Everything is Lua (Luau). There is no compiler, no package manager, and no
bundler — deliberately. A game script is a single function that receives a
context table and builds its own UI.

## Core files

- [main.lua](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Alexchad-code/Abyssal/main/main.lua):
  The entry point. Loads the UI library, builds the window, picks the game
  script from the `GAMES` manifest, runs it, and owns the unload path.
- [games/universal.lua](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Alexchad-code/Abyssal/main/games/universal.lua):
  Runs in every game. Rejoin, server hop, copy JobId, ping watchdog.
- [games/_template.lua](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Alexchad-code/Abyssal/main/games/_template.lua):
  The reference for adding a game. Heavily commented. Never loaded.

## Documentation

- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Alexchad-code/Abyssal/main/AGENTS.md):
  Instructions for AI agents. The `ctx` contract, the conventions, and the rules
  that are not obvious. Read this first.
- [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Alexchad-code/Abyssal/main/README.md):
  Overview and usage for humans.
- [docs/adding-a-game.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Alexchad-code/Abyssal/main/docs/adding-a-game.md):
  Step by step, from copying the template to shipping.
- [docs/how-it-works.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Alexchad-code/Abyssal/main/docs/how-it-works.md):
  What happens between execution and the window appearing.

## Licensing

- [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Alexchad-code/Abyssal/main/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md):
  Obsidian's MIT notice and the rules a consumer must follow.
- [LICENSE](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Alexchad-code/Abyssal/main/LICENSE):
  MIT.

**Do not add third-party code without a licence file.** No licence means all
rights reserved; attribution does not grant permission. This is stated at length
in AGENTS.md because it has already caused a permanent account ban once.

## Optional

- [libs/obsidian/Library.lua](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Alexchad-code/Abyssal/main/libs/obsidian/Library.lua):
  The vendored UI library. Third-party; do not edit.
- [libs/obsidian/Example.lua](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Alexchad-code/Abyssal/main/libs/obsidian/Example.lua):
  Upstream's API example. The best reference for Obsidian's widget API.
